content.title: MV Oil: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: HOUSTON (AP) — MV Oil Trust (MVO) on Monday reported net income of $2.1 million in its third quarter. The Houston-based company said it had profit of 19 cents per share. The oil and gas statutory trust posted revenue of $2.4 million in the period.

content.title: MV Oil: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: HOUSTON (AP) — MV Oil Trust (MVO) on Tuesday reported earnings of $3.2 million in its second quarter. The Houston-based company said it had profit of 28 cents per share. The oil and gas statutory trust posted revenue of $3.4 million in the period.
